SaaS conference meeting booking

Turn your next SaaS conference into sales pipeline.

Tickets, flights and hotels add up fast. We book qualified sales meetings for your team before the event, so you arrive with a full calendar instead of hoping for hallway conversations.

Plan your next SaaS event with us

How do you book sales meetings at a SaaS conference? Start 6-8 weeks before the event. Build a list of attendees, exhibitors, speakers and target accounts that match your ICP, then reach them by email, LinkedIn and phone with a specific reason to meet. Offer short meetings at a set place and time, confirm them before the show, and follow up afterward. A8Z runs this end to end for B2B SaaS vendors at events such as SaaStr AI Annual, Dreamforce, Web Summit and AI Growth Summit.

Who we reach for you

  • Founders, CEOs and revenue leaders at your target accounts
  • Marketing, RevOps, product and technical leaders, depending on who buys your product
  • Attendees we find through social listening who post that they're going and match your ICP
  • Exhibitors, sponsors and speakers who fit as customers or partners

How it works

  1. 6-8 weeks out: Target list

    We map who will be at the event and filter to your ICP, starting with the accounts you most want to meet.

  2. 4-6 weeks out: Outreach

    Personalized email, LinkedIn and phone outreach that references the event and gives a real reason to meet.

  3. Event week: Calendar and reminders

    Every meeting lands on the right person's calendar with context. We send reminders and handle reschedules.

  4. After the event: Follow-up

    We follow up with the people you met and those who couldn't make it, so the event keeps building your sales pipeline.

SaaS conference meeting booking questions

How many weeks before a SaaS conference should we start?

6-8 weeks before the event. List building takes 1-2 weeks, and outreach works best 4-6 weeks out, before calendars fill up. Starting later still works for a shorter list of top accounts.

Do we need a booth or sponsorship?

No. We can book meetings at side events, nearby cafes and hotel lobbies, or at the prospect's own booth. If you have a booth, we can bring meetings to it.

Who is a good fit?

B2B SaaS vendors sending a small team to a conference without a dedicated SDR team to run pre-event outreach.

Can you keep generating sales meetings after the event?

Yes. Many of the same steps power our outbound as a service, which generates qualified sales meetings every month.

Which SaaS event is next on your calendar?

Tell us the event and your ICP. We'll tell you how we'd approach booking your meetings.
